items.title: 動画技術駆動の広告視聴体験向上
items.summary: Advertisements serve as a crucial revenue source for ABEMA - the future of TV that offers free viewing access.  To this end, AbemaTV's video engineers have consistently made ongoing technological investments in video advertising.  However, the evolution of advertising products through video advertising technology isn't solely focused on improving profitability.  It's also about enhancing viewers' overall experience when watching both programs and advertisements, ultimately transforming ABEMA into a more enjoyable content platform.  This presentation describes how video technology including SSAI, CSAI, SGAI, and many other options can be applied to evolve the advertisement viewing experience; plus, it addresses the unique challenges and solutions arising from these different ad insertion techniques.
